nodes.title: SG-5.1 Rebuild HeaderOverlay on the kit
nodes.body:
Context: HeaderOverlay (game/frontend/src/components/HeaderOverlay.tsx) already shows StoryForge, the world title, round id, status, Countdown, a Retry button on error, and sound and settings buttons wired to useUiStore. It is unstyled text inside .sf-frame-bar. The Suggest What Happens Next button is a separate frame button in App.tsx. Desired behavior: the header shows a gold logo, a world-name plaque, a status pill with dot and round id, the countdown, a gold + SUGGEST WHAT HAPPENS NEXT button that opens the contribution dialog, and sound and settings icons. Expected result: the header reads real round data and the old standalone Suggest button is gone. Why: the SG-5 goal replaces the placeholder look with the framed interface.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given a loaded round, when the header renders, then it shows the logo, the world-name plaque, a status pill containing a status dot, the round id and the status, and the countdown timer.
- Given the header is rendered, when the player clicks the gold suggest button, then the contribution dialog opens.
- Given the round is loading, failed or missing, when the header renders, then the pill shows the loading, error with Retry, or no-active-round state.
- Given the header is rendered, when the player clicks the sound or settings icon, then uiStore soundEnabled or settingsOpen changes.


## Scope
- In scope: HeaderOverlay layout and styling on the frame kit
- In scope: gold suggest button inside the header
- In scope: status pill with dot
- In scope: header tests
- Out of scope: StoryPanel (SG-5.2)
- Out of scope: new art
- Out of scope: backend changes
- Out of scope: audio
- Preserve: Round and error props of HeaderOverlay
- Preserve: uiStore actions
- Preserve: ContributionSheet flow and focus return
- Preserve: Countdown behavior


## Technical constraints
- Phaser stays on 3.90.x; React, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind, Radix and Zustand stay.
- Keep the Go API contracts and the contribution flow; no mock data in place of real API calls.
- Colours come from the shared palette tokens; fonts are bundled npm packages; no downloaded art or CDN links.
- Tests are unit tests with all dependencies mocked.


## Definition of done
- All requirements are done and their Verify units pass.


## Non-functional requirements
- Keyboard operable buttons with accessible names


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · Header is a wood bar with brass corners, gold logo, world plaque, status pill with dot and countdown
nodes.body:
Context: HeaderOverlay renders plain spans in .sf-frame-bar. Desired behavior: gold logo text, the world title inside a plaque frame (Frame kind plaque), and a pill holding a status dot, the round id and status, then the Countdown, with brass corner decoration. Expected result: visible kit structure with test ids. Why: matches the reference header.

## Acceptance criteria

- Given a world title, when the header renders, then the title is inside an element with data-frame plaque.
- Given a round, when the header renders, then the logo text StoryForge, the header banner with brass corners class, and one timer are present.


## Scope
- In scope: HeaderOverlay markup
- In scope: CSS for logo, pill, dot and brass corners using palette tokens
- Out of scope: Suggest button
- Out of scope: new PNG art
- Preserve: Countdown component
- Preserve: existing text StoryForge, round id and status strings

- Phaser 3.90.x pin untouched.


## Dependencies
- INT


## Definition of done

- styles added


## Non-functional requirements

## Clarifying questions

nodes.title: REQ · Gold + SUGGEST WHAT HAPPENS NEXT header button opens the contribution dialog
nodes.body:
Context: the Suggest button is a frame button in App.tsx scene slot with triggerRef. Desired behavior: move it into HeaderOverlay as a gold button labelled + SUGGEST WHAT HAPPENS NEXT, keeping the accessible name Suggest What Happens Next and focus return. Expected result: one suggest button, in the header; App no longer renders the old one. Why: matches the reference and removes the replaced path.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given the header with onSuggest, when the player clicks the button named Suggest What Happens Next, then onSuggest is called once.
- Given App after Begin, when the player clicks that button, then the contribution dialog opens and exactly one such button exists.
- Given the dialog closes, when Escape is pressed, then focus returns to the header button.


## Scope
- In scope: gold Button variant
- In scope: HeaderOverlay props onSuggest and suggestRef
- In scope: App wiring and removal of the old button
- Out of scope: ContributionSheet internals
- Preserve: contribution API flow
- Preserve: focus return via returnFocusRef


## Technical constraints
- Keep contribution flow and Go API contracts.
- Radix dialog stays.


## Dependencies
- INT


## Definition of done
- Old button removed from App.tsx

nodes.title: REQ · Pill and icon controls cover loading, error with retry, empty and sound and settings states
nodes.body:
Context: error, loading and empty states render as bare spans, and icon buttons are plain frame buttons. Desired behavior: the state messages appear inside the same pill (test id round-pill with data-state loading, error or empty), Retry stays a frame button, and sound and settings icons sit in a labelled control group. Expected result: every status is covered and wired to real props and uiStore. Why: the Done-when requires tests for loading, error and retry.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given loading, when rendered, then the pill has data-state loading with text Loading round… and no timer.
- Given error, when rendered, then the pill has data-state error with role alert text Round unavailable: <error> and Retry calls onRetry once.
- Given no round, when rendered, then the pill has data-state empty with No active round.
- Given the icon group, when sound or settings is clicked, then uiStore changes.


## Scope
- In scope: HeaderOverlay state markup
- In scope: icon group
- Out of scope: App round loading logic
- Preserve: messages text
- Preserve: Retry behavior
- Preserve: uiStore wiring


## Technical constraints
- No mock data in place of API; Zustand store stays.


## Dependencies
- REQ1


## Definition of done
- States render in the pill


## Non-functional requirements
- role alert kept


## Clarifying questions
- None
